properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the Bitcoin consensus curve: keys, addresses and signatures in the wallet are ECDSA/secp256k1 by protocol, so that portion is replaceable only by the Bitcoin ecosystem. The library also carries the WabiSabi coinjoin protocol's curve operations (ECDH-style credential math), which the Wasabi project itself controls.
